findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Know where to open your next store." → 3 lines (7 words, 77.8px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "How StoreScout Works" above "From possible locations to a clear inves"; "DaypartDNA + Future Infrastructure" above "The same location can be busy at differe"; "Daypart Opportunity" above "94"; "Transit Access Score" above "62"; "FailFast Risk Diagnosis" above "A good location. A bad investment?"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 9 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "How StoreScout Works", "STEP 01", "STEP 02", "STEP 03").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.daypart-map-container → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03) 0px 4px 20px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 10 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.header 1440px | section#hero.hero-section 1440px | section#how-it-works.section-wrapper.tint-bg 1440px | section#daypart-dna.section-wrapper 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 72px on the left, 88px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 646px of the width empty: "What if a new metro station opens nearby?".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
